summary: The request model is the rulebook at the door and the response model is the filter at the exit. You send a request with three mistakes and read the 422, write your own validator, and see a response model drop a field that must not leak.
goal: Send a bad request, get a 422, and read the error.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then guess the hook
Step 1: replace api.py with the worked example, then send a good question (200) and a blank one (422)
Step 2: change le=10 to le=5, predict what top_k 7 does, then check
Step 3: send three mistakes at once and read each loc and msg, then remove response_model and watch internal_note leak
Step 4: add an optional tag and a used_top_k field, and test tag 123 to get a 422
Play the Validation Referee game to the end and see your score
